defects.shared_tmp: As amendment 01, for jobs that were already running when it was recorded.
defects.shm_psm_missing: vLLM start-up failed because a psm_* POSIX shared-memory segment in the node-wide /dev/shm disappeared (FileNotFoundError). The cause was not established; Singularity cannot bind a private directory onto /dev, so no fix is applied.
defects.port_race: vLLM's TCPStore failed to bind an ephemeral port taken by a co-located job. run_grpo_mi250x.slurm now sets a job-specific VLLM_PORT base.

not_rerun: Job 23032954 ('Memory usage increased after sleeping', a vLLM sleep-mode self-check) shows none of these defects and keeps its recorded non-memory outcome. Diagnosed memory failures are never rerun.
